mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t_market_analysis_daily ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键自增' PRIMARY KEY, market_date DATE NOT NULL COMMENT '交易日（按天唯一）', analysis_time DATETIME COMMENT '本次实时分析的采集时间', market_phase VARCHAR(20) COMMENT '数据阶段：盘前/竞价/早盘/盘中/尾盘/已收盘/非交易时段', market_status VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '市场在做什么（一句话结论）', sentiment_score INT COMMENT '市场情绪温度0-100', sentiment_level VARCHAR(20) COMMENT '情绪档位：冰点/低迷/中性/活跃/亢奋', sh_close DECIMAL(12, 2) COMMENT '上证指数点位', sh_change_pct DECIMAL(8, 4) COMMENT '上证涨跌幅%', sz_close DECIMAL(12, 2) COMMENT '深证成指点位', sz_change_pct DECIMAL(8, 4) COMMENT '深证成指涨跌幅%', cyb_close DECIMAL(12, 2) COMMENT '创业板指点位', cyb_change_pct DECIMAL(8, 4) COMMENT '创业板指涨跌幅%', kc50_close DECIMAL(12, 2) COMMENT '科创50点位', kc50_change_pct DECIMAL(8, 4) COMMENT '科创50涨跌幅%', total_amount DECIMAL(20, 2) COMMENT '两市实时成交额(元)', prev_total_amount DECIMAL(20, 2) COMMENT '昨日全天两市成交额(元)', amount_ratio DECIMAL(8, 4) COMMENT '今日实时/昨日全天成交额比', up_count INT COMMENT '全市场上涨家数', down_count INT COMMENT '全市场下跌家数', flat_count INT COMMENT '全市场平盘家数', limit_up_count INT COMMENT '涨停家数', limit_down_count INT COMMENT '跌停家数', zha_ban_count INT COMMENT '炸板家数', zha_ban_rate DECIMAL(8, 4) COMMENT '炸板率%', max_lianban INT COMMENT '最高连板数', lianban_stocks TEXT COMMENT '连板梯队JSON', main_net_inflow DECIMAL(20, 2) COMMENT '全市场主力净流入(元)', ultra_net_inflow DECIMAL(20, 2) COMMENT '超大单净流入(元)', big_net_inflow DECIMAL(20, 2) COMMENT '大单净流入(元)', mid_net_inflow DECIMAL(20, 2) COMMENT '中单净流入(元)', small_net_inflow DECIMAL(20, 2) COMMENT '小单净流入(元)', margin_balance DECIMAL(20, 2) COMMENT '两融余额(元,T-1)', margin_net_buy DECIMAL(20, 2) COMMENT '融资净买入(元,T-1)', hot_sectors TEXT COMMENT '主拉板块TOP JSON', cold_sectors TEXT COMMENT '主弃板块 JSON', main_line VARCHAR(1000) COMMENT '市场主线（规则初判）', main_line_sustainability VARCHAR(500) COMMENT '主线持续性规则初判', leaders TEXT COMMENT '主线龙头股JSON（含新手可买标记）', news_highlights TEXT COMMENT '核心消息面JSON', ai_market_status LONGTEXT COMMENT 'AI：市场在做什么/情绪综合', ai_logic LONGTEXT COMMENT 'AI：核心消息面与驱动逻辑', ai_money_flow LONGTEXT COMMENT 'AI：资金流向与增量退场判断', ai_mainline LONGTEXT COMMENT 'AI：主线板块与持续性判断', ai_outlook LONGTEXT COMMENT 'AI：明日展望', ai_history_review LONGTEXT COMMENT 'AI：历史分析准确性复盘', realtime_json LONGTEXT COMMENT '实时快照全量JSON（历史对比复盘用）', create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间', UNIQUE KEY uk_market_date (market_date) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_general_ci COMMENT = '市场实时分析每日宽表（按天存储，同天重分析先删后插）'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_market_analysis_daily WHERE market_date = DATE(#{marketDate})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_market_analysis_daily ( market_date, analysis_time, market_phase, market_status, sentiment_score, sentiment_level, sh_close, sh_change_pct, sz_close, sz_change_pct, cyb_close, cyb_change_pct, kc50_close, kc50_change_pct, total_amount, prev_total_amount, amount_ratio, up_count, down_count, flat_count, limit_up_count, limit_down_count, zha_ban_count, zha_ban_rate, max_lianban, lianban_stocks, main_net_inflow, ultra_net_inflow, big_net_inflow, mid_net_inflow, small_net_inflow, margin_balance, margin_net_buy, hot_sectors, cold_sectors, main_line, main_line_sustainability, leaders, news_highlights, ai_market_status, ai_logic, ai_money_flow, ai_mainline, ai_outlook, ai_history_review, realtime_json ) VALUES ( #{marketDate}, #{analysisTime}, #{marketPhase}, #{marketStatus}, #{sentimentScore}, #{sentimentLevel}, #{shClose}, #{shChangePct}, #{szClose}, #{szChangePct}, #{cybClose}, #{cybChangePct}, #{kc50Close}, #{kc50ChangePct}, #{totalAmount}, #{prevTotalAmount}, #{amountRatio}, #{upCount}, #{downCount}, #{flatCount}, #{limitUpCount}, #{limitDownCount}, #{zhaBanCount}, #{zhaBanRate}, #{maxLianban}, #{lianbanStocks}, #{mainNetInflow}, #{ultraNetInflow}, #{bigNetInflow}, #{midNetInflow}, #{smallNetInflow}, #{marginBalance}, #{marginNetBuy}, #{hotSectors}, #{coldSectors}, #{mainLine}, #{mainLineSustainability}, #{leaders}, #{newsHighlights}, #{aiMarketStatus}, #{aiLogic}, #{aiMoneyFlow}, #{aiMainline}, #{aiOutlook}, #{aiHistoryReview}, #{realtimeJson} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_market_analysis_daily WHERE market_date = DATE(#{marketDate}) LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_market_analysis_daily ORDER BY market_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
